_comment: Shared score fixtures. Both engines must agree on `score` and `band` for every case. Read by tests/score-parity.test.mjs (JS + the Rust CLI) and by build/score/tests/fixtures.rs (the Rust lib directly). Add a case here and both sides pick it up. `passed` is how many of the 8 checks should pass, kept so a fixture that drifts is obvious.

cases.name: perfect post, exact fraction
cases.why: 8/8 = 100 exactly; agreed even before the rounding fix

post.body: A long enough body to keep a stranger reading past the first line of it.
post.cta: Reply with the one metric you track

cases.name: three of eight, the original off-by-one
cases.why: 3/8 = 37.5. JS Math.round gave 38, integer truncation gave 37. THIS is the case that failed yesterday.

post.best_form: Visual first, caption as a story with a save-worthy closer

cases.name: seven of eight, hook echoes the cta
cases.why: 7/8 = 87.5. JS 88, truncation 87. Also exercises hook-cta-echo failing alone.

post.hook: Reply with the one metric you track
post.body: A long enough body to keep a stranger reading past the first line of it.

cases.name: seven of eight, over the character ceiling
cases.why: Same 7/8 arithmetic reached a different way — length fails instead of echo.

cases.name: six of eight, no bestForm
cases.why: 6/8 = 75 exactly. Divides evenly, so it agreed even with the bug — the control case.

post.body: A long enough body to keep a stranger reading past the first line of it.

cases.name: four of eight, band edge from below
cases.why: 4/8 = 50 exactly. Sits under the 55 draft threshold, so a one-point drift would not move the band but would move the number.

post.best_form: Visual first, caption as a story with a save-worthy closer

cases.name: five of eight, straddles the draft threshold
cases.why: 5/8 = 62.5. JS 63, truncation 62. Both land in draft, but the number differs — the kind of drift a band-only assertion misses.

post.body: A long enough body to keep a stranger reading past the first line of it.
post.best_form: Visual first, caption as a story with a save-worthy closer

cases.name: empty post
cases.why: The state the canvas opens in. Scores 5/8 = 62.5 (JS 63, truncation 62), because an empty post still passes hook-cta-echo, length, media-on-x, tags and form. Worth knowing: a blank draft already reads as `draft`, not `thin`.
